title: No footage until the Lady allowed filming

tellings.quote: Well, let me tell you, from 2007 to 2012, I had zero data. I was out every night with a camera trying to get pictures to save myself from the community, right?

plain: A North Carolina man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he has long had UFO encounters behind his house, says that from 2007 to 2012 he went out every night with a camera and captured nothing at all. He says he was desperate for pictures to clear his name with neighbours who doubted him, and that footage only came once a being he calls the Lady allowed it. If true, it would mean whatever he meets decides when it can be seen.
